title.narrative: Agricultural Transformation Project in the North of Senegal (North Agropole)

description.narrative:
As part of the operationalization of the Senegal Emerging Plan (PSE), particularly in its pillar relating to the "structural transformation of the economy and growth", the Senegalese Government wishes to implement the North Agropole Project for the sustainable transformation of the agricultural production system in order to contribute to a transfer of investments and human resources from agriculture to agro-industry.
Identified among the 27 flagship projects of the PSE as one of the decisive levers for achieving food sovereignty and progressing in industrialization, the North Agropole project will contribute to: (i) increase the production of priority sectors, (ii) develop the ecosystem of private investment in the agro-industrial sector, (iii) increase the rate of processing of agricultural products, (iv) contribute to the creation of decent and sustainable jobs and (v) contribute to the structural transformation of Senegal's economy.
The overall objective of the project is to contribute to improving the living conditions of populations (including young people and women) through the creation of added value on agricultural products and the sustainable increase in the productivity of priority agro-industrial sectors (rice, onions, meat).
